# Tribeca Dental Studio

> Comprehensive multi-specialty dental practice in Lower Manhattan (Tribeca, NYC), specializing in cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, general surgery, pediatric orthodontics, and laser dentistry.

## Primary Pages & Information

- [Homepage](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/): Overview of practice, multi-specialty offerings, and clinical team.
- [About Us](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/about): History, patient-first care philosophy, and office details.
- [Our Team](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/team): Profiles and credentials of specialists and attending dentists.
- [Smile Gallery](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/cases): Case studies and clinical before-and-after results.
- [Your First Visit](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/your-first-visit): Guidance, expectations, and intake details for new patients.
- [Insurance & Financing](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/insurance): Coverage options, payment plans, and financial policies.

## Clinical Services

- [Cosmetic Dentistry & Veneers](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/services/porcelain-veneers-lumineers): Porcelain veneers, Lumineers, and smile design.
- [Teeth Whitening](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/services/teeth-whitening): In-office whitening treatments.
- [Invisalign Clear Aligners](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/services/invisalign-clear-aligner-braces): Orthodontic alignment for adults and teens.
- [Dental Implants](https://implants.tribecadentalstudio.com/): Single implants, full arch reconstruction, and All-on-4®.
- [Pain Free Dentistry](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/pain-free-dentistry): Needle-free Biolase laser and sedation dentistry options.
- [General Exams & Cleanings](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/services/dental-checkups-teeth-cleaning): Preventive hygiene and oral health assessments.

## Technology & Expertise

- [Leading Edge Technology](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/leading-edge-technology): Biolase laser, iTero 3D scanners, CBCT 3D imaging, and digital diagnostic tools.
- [Best Dentist in NYC](https://tribecadentalstudio.com/best-dentist-in-nyc): Clinical distinctions and Tribeca practice recognition.
